text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a concise SI co-sell handoff that covers cloud marketplace listings, HW partner joint demos, and SI-led outbound. Goal: no duplicate outreach and a single source of truth for ownership. I sketched a lightweight flow below, please react with :thumbsup: or suggest edits.

aj: tl;dr? what changes for AEs today?

maria: Short: add a 48h automatic claim window for SI-assigned leads, then fallback to Redwood AE. Marketplaces (AWS/GCP/Azure) leads follow marketplace intake ownership unless tagged SI-referral. HW partner leads default to SI if SI introduced at PoC stage.

kevin: Can we have a clear account-mapping example? recent case with AcmeCorp got messy.

maria: Yep. Example mapping (pseudo-sf rules):
```
if lead.source == "marketplace" and lead.referrer == "SI" -> owner = SI_partner
elif lead.source == "hardware_partner" and SI_introduced == true -> owner = SI_partner
elif account.status == "existing" -> owner = Redwood_AE
else -> owner = Redwood_AE (auto-claim after 48h)
```

sylvie: For joint announcements — we need a single timeline owner. Proposal: Redwood comms own press + joint blog if SI opts in; SI handles direct customer notification. Add a checklist item: PR review at least 5 business days ahead.

aj: What's the SLA for SI responses on marketplace leads? we need a number.

maria: Recommend 48 hours to accept claim and 5 business days to respond to first outreach. If SI doesn't claim in 48h, AE gets auto-assigned and outreach email template fires.

kevin: Sounds fair. Where do we log the acceptance? SFDC + a partner_claim tag?

maria: Yes — tag = "si_claimed" + partner name. Orch-bot will monitor and post claim events in #partnerships. Sample SFDC note snippet in onboarding doc.

orch-bot: Reminder: new rule deployed to staging intake pipeline. Watch for duplicate detection regressions.

aj: Any exceptions for enterprise deals > $1M? SI can co-own but we need VP approval to hand full ownership.

maria: Agreed — add a governance exception: deals > $1M require reps + Partner Lead + RevOps signoff. Put this as a checkbox in the intake form.

kevin: One operational ask: can we auto-populate the partner-intro email with marketplace listing link + joint runbook for demo? saves manual steps.

sylvie: I'll add templates to the shared drive and give edit access to top 10 SI PMs.

maria: Action items:
- kevin: update SFDC claim tag + automation (due EOD Fri)
- aj: update AE playbook with 48h rule + exception flow (due Tue)
- sylvie: publish templates and PR checklist (due Thu)
- revops: add a validation rule for partner_name when "si_claimed" = true

aj: acked. I'll also ping legal about joint announcement NDA language.

kevin: I'll start a short runbook for HW partner demos — include logistics (lab, image, P0 test cases).

maria: Thanks — if no objections we'll ship this playbook next week and start a 2-week pilot with Concert SI (gold) and one hardware partner. If you want edits, drop them inline here. :rocket:
